title: Business set-up
intro: These answers tell every AI in this repo what your agency is. The facts go into CLAUDE.md, under About the business. Your choices go into DECISIONS.md.

questions.text: What is your agency called, and what is your name?

questions.help: One or two lines, in your own words. For example: done-for-you campaigns that book sales calls.
The kind of company, its size, and the person who says yes.

questions.text: How do new clients find you?
How many clients do you have now, and how many do you want in 12 months?
How many people work in the agency, you included?
Which tools does the team use every day?
questions.help: Names only. Never a login or a key.

questions.text: Which AI coding tool will you use with this OS?
What is the one goal this OS must help with this year?
questions.help: Write it in your own words. The AI keeps your words.
